steps.js: window.__dmhHold = true; const g = window.__dmh, P = g.player; g.godMode = true; for (const z of g.zones) z.unlocked = true; window.aimNear = () => { let b=null,bd=1e9; for (const E of g.enemies){ if(E.dead||E.emerging) continue; const d=E.pos.distanceTo(P.pos); if(d<bd){bd=d;b=E;} } if(b){ const d=b.pos.clone().sub(g.camera.position); P.yaw=Math.atan2(-d.x,-d.z); P.pitch=Math.atan2(d.y,Math.hypot(d.x,d.z)); } return b; }; window.goRound = (r) => { for (const E of g.enemies) { E.dead=true; E.remove=true; } P.closeMenu(); g.round = r-1; g.startRound(); }; const U=g.data.upgrades; JSON.stringify({total: U.length, gun: U.filter(u=>u.gun).length, cls: U.filter(u=>u.cls).length, buffs: U.filter(u=>!u.gun&&!u.cls&&u.rarity!=='Cursed').length, per: ['gunslinger','brawler','engineer','sniper','bomber'].map(c=>U.filter(u=>u.cls===c).length)})

(async()=>{const g=__dmh,P=g.player; const st=P.upgradeStacks.slice(); const seen={}; let rep=0; for(let i=0;i<60;i++){ const r=[0,0,0,1,1,2,2,3][i%8]; const u=await window.__roll(r, st, P.cls.id); if(u<0) continue; if(st[u]>0) rep++; st[u]=(st[u]||0)+1; seen[u]=1; } return 'sixty chests: distinct '+Object.keys(seen).length+' repeats '+rep+' class '+P.cls.id})()

(async()=>{const g=__dmh,P=g.player,U=g.data.upgrades; const out=[]; for (const id of ['gunslinger','brawler','engineer','sniper','bomber']) { P.setClass(id); for(let i=179;i<U.length;i++){ if(U[i].cls && U[i].cls!==P.cls.id) continue; if(!U[i].gun) P.addUpgrade(i); } P.recompute(); g.godMode=false; P.maxHealthBonus=0; goRound(8); __sim(500); const k0=P.kills; let died=0; for (let k=0;k<700;k++){ if(P.dead){died++; P.revive&&P.revive(); } P.health=Math.max(P.health,60); aimNear(); if(k===200) P.setWield(true); if(k===450) P.setWield(false); __sim(1, {fire:true, firePressed:1, aim:k%120>100, jump: k%90===0?1:0, dash: k%140===0?1:0, grapple:k%160===0?1:0, grenade:k%110===0?1:0, melee:k%70===0?1:0}); } out.push(P.cls.id+' kills '+(P.kills-k0)+' hp '+Math.round(P.health)+'/'+Math.round(P.maxHealth)+' shield '+Math.round(P.overshield)+' died '+died+' streak '+(P.streak||0)+' killHP '+(P.killHP||0)); g.godMode=true; } return out.join(' | ')})()
